rapport_notes: Friendly and efficient; good practical follow-up on the heavy desk/lift-gate detail.

evidence_quotes.agenda: do you have any questions or concerns that you would specifically like answered on this call in regards to the move?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'No... we've done this job before including literally just a couple of days ago' -- no concern raised to dig into.

top_strength: Picked up on the customer's own admission of experience ('we've done this job before') and adjusted pacing accordingly, keeping the call efficient without skipping key logistics like the lift-gate need for the heavy desk.
coaching_note: Skipped the differentiators pitch (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee) entirely -- even a fast-moving repeat customer should hear these before booking.
